about: Golden cases for M1, meetings from mail. Every name, address and exchange is invented. `body` is the conversation note as the pass reads it (`### Sender — sent`, then the email). `expect` is what a person reading the emails would put on the agenda, one line per meeting: `fixed <start stamp>` or `cancelled <day>`, plus ` @ <place>` when the place matters. `oracle` is an answer a perfect model would give, written by hand: replaying it through `meetings::parse` and `meetings::resolve` must give `expect`, which is what the CI test checks. `recorded` holds real models' answers from live runs (`tests/eval_meetings.rs`). `here`, when present, is the reader's own clock (a zone name or offset): a time the emails put on another clock must come out on this one (2026-10-23).
